content.residual_and_down_output_coordinate_rule: For each model hidden dimension d, use floor(sqrt(d*(2^42-16)-1)) f12 as guarded down-output/residual coordinate cap; each residual RMS input must additionally satisfy the full row-square budget. For Q/K RMS input use min(main cap, the d=128 coordinate cap) plus the same row budget.
content.RMS_sum_guard_rule: First secretly range-check every coordinate, square only its safe replacement. For each term, compare term > limit - current_sum, accumulate secret failure, select zero for an over-budget term, and only then add; neither subtraction nor addition exceeds the public limit. Do not add then check. On any row error select the entire vector zero and a=F24 (k=0) before NR; otherwise use exactly floor(S/d)+16. All scans and choices are fixed-shape secure operations.
content.RMS_mean_proof: floor(S/d)+16 <= 2^42-1 iff S <= d*(2^42-16)-1. Positive epsilon16 gives minimum k=-10; maximum k=8. The d<=2048 scaled-vector96 and the existing six-round NR bounds therefore remain applicable.

L2_domain.proof: For 1<=S<=2^52-1, floor((bit_length(S)-1-24)/2) lies in [-12,13]. Use the same pre-accumulation guard and prescribed invalid/zero dummy, preserving retrieval f20 output bounds.

content.PV_probability_mass_proof: All exponential outputs E_j are nonnegative and <=F. The safe maximum/dummy-key rule guarantees one E_j=F, so F<=D=sum(E_j)<=1280F. k=floor(log2 D)-24 gives D<2^(k+1)F. After NR state checks, 0<=r<=2F and R=floor(r/2^k), so sum floor(E_j R/F)<=D R/F<4F. Any subsequent probability range replacement only reduces this mass. Thus abs(any raw PV partial sum)<4F*V_cap_f12, not 1280F*V_cap_f12.
content.PV_safe_substitution_branches: Invalid query or no allowed key uses exactly one dummy key whose exponent is F, giving D=F. NR state substitution remains in [0,2F]. Even an independently considered D<F reciprocal fallback gives mass <=D*(2F)/F<2F; D>1280F cannot occur under E_j<=F and N<=1280. Per-probability out-of-range substitution is zero and can only reduce nonnegative mass. After floor24 the attention-output ordinary-domain check is still required; <4M raw-derived output is not a guarantee of <=M.
content.SiLU_safe_substitution_bound: For denominator F+exp(|x|) in [F,2F], checked NR state only implies reciprocal<=2F, and exp<=F implies negative-side sigmoid<=2F. Therefore raw x*sigmoid is bounded by 2*M*2^36, without assuming convergence or sigmoid<=F. The existing output-domain check at M is retained BEFORE the SwiGLU joint; checked up also has bound M, so joint<=M^2 remains valid.
